title: Realization and contractibility of a standard simplex
statement: Use the standard simplices and ordinary geometric realization of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For every integer $n\geq0$, the realization $|\Delta^n|$ is homeomorphic to the topological simplex $T_n=\{(t_0,\ldots,t_n)\in\mathbb R^{n+1}:t_i\geq0,\ \sum_i t_i=1\}$. Both $T_n$ and $|\Delta^n|$ are contractible topological spaces, meaning homotopy equivalent to a one-point space.
